summary: Một danh sách tuyển tập plugin, kỹ năng và tài nguyên cho OpenAI Codex và ChatGPT, hoạt động như thư viện #1 cho Codex.
usecases: Discover and install Codex plugins to extend AI coding assistance for specific languages or frameworks.
Integrate Codex skills into CI/CD pipelines to auto-generate boilerplate, tests, or documentation.
Serve as a reference for building custom AI-powered developer tools or marketplace platforms.
ideas: Develop a VS Code extension that fetches and displays this list inline for one-click plugin activation.
Build a community-driven ranking and review system for Codex plugins based on user feedback.
Create a starter kit for developers to publish their own Codex plugins following marketplace conventions.
